allowedSourceMaterial.overview: American Matt Quigley answers Australian land baron Elliott Marston's ad for a sharpshooter to kill the dingoes on his property. But when Quigley finds out that Marston's real target is the aborigines, Quigley hits the road. Now, even American expatriate Crazy Cora can't keep Quigley safe in his cat-and-mouse game with the homicidal Marston.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With a ruthless cattle baron hunting him down and only an erratic expatriate by his side, can one rifleman survive the untamed territory?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Hired by an Australian land baron under the guise of shooting dingoes, American rifleman Matt Quigley rebels when the true human quarry is revealed, triggering a lethal cat-and-mouse chase across the rugged Outback.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Exciting and suspenseful, this Outback chase moves at a steady clip with engaged focus and moderate grit.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Simon Wincer retools the Western frontier into an expansive Australian survival pursuit, powered by sharpshooting tension, moral clarity, and escalating open-country suspense.
